title: Chelsea: the Touchline Take on the latest
body:
Sky Sports has a story involving Chelsea [S1]. The headline said it plainly: “Chelsea frustrated at Hacken in WCL” [S1]. For context, BBC Sport also ran: “Chelsea play out goalless draw with Hacken” [S2].

In our Football-Data.co.uk results, Chelsea have 3 wins, 0 draws and 2 defeats from their last 5 league games: 9 points, 9 scored and 4 conceded [ST1].

It is a story worth keeping an eye on as the season unfolds. There is more to this than the headline suggests. The Touchline Take: one to keep an eye on.

evidence.text: Sky Sports: Chelsea frustrated at Hacken in WCL. Chelsea remain unbeaten in the Women’s Champions League but they were frustrated in a goalless draw at BK Hacken.

BBC Sport: Chelsea play out goalless draw with Hacken. Chelsea maintain their unbeaten start in the Women's Champions League but were frustrated by Hacken who pick up their second point in this season's competition.
